Seed 0 grid of 160x72 with 40 wall blocks: breadth first checks 9,272 cells (99.9% of the walkable grid), A star checks 351, 26.4 to 1, and both return the same 223-cell shortest path. A perfect maze gave only 1.03 to 1 and plain A* 5,983 checks; rectangular blocks plus the prefer-higher-g tie break made the claim. Narration says 'flood fill' because piper says 'breadth' as 'breath'. https://youtu.be/tp5SPF6mIEo
